title: Pseudo-relativistic fermionic systems with attractive Yukawa potential
summary: We study the Hartree-Fock and Hartree-Fock-Bogoliubov theories for a large fermionic system with the pseudo-relativistic kinetic energy and an attractive Yukawa interaction potential. We prove that the system is stable if and only if the total mass does not excess a critical value, and investigate the existence and properties of ground states in both sub-critical and critical mass regimes.
